newsitem.title: FRANCE: French magazine ad pages rise 9.8 pct Jan-Feb '97.
newsitem.headline: French magazine ad pages rise 9.8 pct Jan-Feb '97.

text.p: The number of advertising pages carried in French magazines rose 9.8 percent in January and February of this year compared with the same two-month period of last year, according to a monthly report published by advertising space specialist Mediapolis.
It said in its April report that the rise represented 830 extra advertising pages.
"The first half of 1997 seems to be continuing its rising trend," Mediapolis said. DT/SLA
